item.title: 'You're no longer my sister' - rows erupt as war divides Iranian families
item.summary: People in Iran describe angry scenes and tense relationships as rifts open up over the war.

item.title: Israel says it will keep control over part of southern Lebanon after war with Hezbollah ends
item.summary: Defence Minister Israel Katz also says houses in Lebanese villages near the Israeli border will be demolished.

item.title: Iran using children in security roles in war, reports and witnesses say
item.summary: An 11-year-old is reported to have been killed in an air strike while manning a checkpoint in Tehran.

item.title: Peacekeepers killed by roadside explosion in Lebanon, initial report finds
item.summary: The deaths of the two Indonesian nationals came less than a day after another UN peacekeeper - also Indonesian - was killed in Lebanon.

item.title: Palestinians convicted of lethal attacks face death penalty under new Israeli law
item.summary: The new law, passed on Monday, was pushed hard by the far-right and Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir.

item.title: Gazan mother reunited with evacuated daughter after two years
item.summary: The girl is among at least eight children who were premature newborns when they were evacuated during heavy fighting in Gaza at the start of the war.

item.title: Latin Patriarch will have access to Jerusalem holy site after police stopped entry
item.summary: The Israeli PM says Cardinal Pierbattista Pizzaballa had been asked not to enter the church over concerns about Iranian strikes.

item.title: Tears and defiance as Lebanese family bury child, 11, killed in Israeli strike
item.summary: Jawad Younes and his uncle Ragheb were laid to rest on Saturday after their family compound was hit a day earlier.

item.title: Palestinian man killed as death toll from West Bank settler violence climbs
item.summary: Mohammad al-Malhi is the seventh Palestinian killed by a settler in a surge of violence since the start of the war with Iran.

item.title: Three Lebanese journalists killed in Israeli strike, say broadcasters
item.summary: The Israeli military confirms it killed Ali Shoeib and Mohamed Ftouni, alleging they also belonged to Hezbollah's military wing.
